legal_reviewer_reference.rule: Must identify a real independent legal/privacy reviewer or authority reference. This preparation cannot create or substitute that review.

approved_processing_role_matrix_document.rule: A real approved processing-role matrix artifact must exist; the candidate receipt stores only its SHA-256.

approved_processing_role_matrix_version.rule: The reviewed matrix version must be explicit and stable enough to bind all supporting evidence.

purpose_to_role_mapping_artifact.rule: Reviewed mapping of processing purposes to controller/operator/processor roles must exist.

purpose_to_legal_basis_review_artifact.rule: Reviewed mapping of processing purposes to legal bases must exist; the collector cannot infer legal basis.

sensitive_data_treatment_review_artifact.rule: Reviewed treatment of sensitive and potentially sensitive fitness/student data must exist.

processor_subprocessor_map_artifact.rule: Reviewed processor/subprocessor map must exist and be bound to the approved role matrix.

international_transfer_mechanism_map_art.rule: Reviewed international-transfer mechanism map must exist when applicable; a reviewed not-applicable conclusion must be explicit rather than inferred.

international_transfer_applicability.rule: Applicability must come from reviewed evidence, never from collector inference.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Hash real reviewed artifacts and record only non-sensitive metadata; no network or database mutation.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Confirm legal/privacy authority, matrix version, purposes, roles, legal bases, sensitive-data treatment, processor map and transfer mechanism conclusion.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real independent review, create a separate versioned migration updating exactly legal_role_mapping with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply the exact merged evidence migration through Supabase.apply_migration only; execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
